text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Wonderfuuul!! So cooool!! I got a whole 
bunch of them!
choice_data_list: That was a piece of cake!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh! By "easy-peasy", do you mean "first 
simmer gently, then bring to a roaring 
boil", yes?!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, the way you grabbed that toy with 
a snap-snap was so cool!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Today is a day of special memories!! Thank 
you!! I'll never, EVER forget this!!
